Modal dialog with no focus management

On load there is nothing here to find: the dialog is display:none and is not in the accessibility tree, so an audit that only runs on page load reports a clean page. Every defect below exists only once the dialog is open.

To exercise it: click #openDialog, wait for #fakeDialog.open, then audit. See the interact field for this fixture in manifest.json.
